segments.text: I lift every single day. I aim for 6 hours of exercise per week, three sessions of cardio and three for strength. I don't do cardio, it screws up the gains. I do 150 minutes of zone two cardio and 75 minutes of vigorous exercise including hit and sprints.

Research shows the combination of these can lower your risk of death by up to 42%. I only do resistance training, man. I incorporate mobility, balance, and flexibility movements into my weekly protocol to keep my body injury-free. I get in late night when the gym is empty. I avoid moderate to high-intensity exercise within 4 hours of bedtime because it can negatively impact sleep and recovery. Consistency is key. You're actually right about that.
